messages:
sara_sales: Heads-up — FinOps Corp is hitting intermittent 429s during their bulk preflight import demo. Demo in ~2h, they're worried it will fail. Can someone triage?

ali_eng: Thanks — can you paste an example request id and any x-rate-limit headers from the response? Also which endpoint: /v1/chat or /v1/embeddings?

mike_support: They sent request-id `req_0a9f3c2` and the client pasted this header block:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1680311285
X-Redwood-Per-Route-Cap: 80
```

sara_sales: It's the embeddings bulk endpoint (POST /v1/embeddings) — they stream ~200 concurrent small documents from their UI. They said the dashboard shows ~6k tokens/min but billing shows a different spike.

jen_sre: That per-route cap 80 sounds like per-socket concurrent request cap. If their client opened 200 concurrent sockets we'll see Ratelimit 429s. Can they batch / reduce concurrency? Quick fix: increase per-route cap for the tenant or apply a short reservation.

ali_eng: Quick checklist: tenant id, env (prod/demo), tenant quota config, and a sample curl we can replay. If someone can share the raw request body (or a redacted sample) we can replay from our side.

mike_support: FinOps provided tenant `finops-87` and redacted payload (list of 50 short texts). Asking for a temp bump and also why tokens are billed on 429s — CFO asked.

jen_sre: Tokens: we bill for received tokens that reached the serving pipeline. If a request reached the tokenization/embedding stage it can increment usage before the rate-limiter returned 429 on concurrency. I can link a short note: it happens when we accept the connection and consume tokens before hitting the global quota check.

ali_eng: For the immediate demo: I can apply a 15-minute per-route cap increase (set Per-Route-Cap->250) for finops-87 and a reserved token window +5k tokens/min to absorb burst. That should keep the demo live. Anyone object?

sara_sales: please do it. Also they'd like a short explanation I can forward to the customer's FinOps lead about the billing behavior.

jen_sre: Doing the config change now. I also enabled verbose sampling for that tenant so we can capture a failed request replay.

quota_bot: Action logged: apply_per_route_cap(finops-87, 250) by jen_sre at 1759876560 — expires in 15m.

mike_support: Rebilling note for customer: "You may see token counts for requests that returned 429 if those requests reached tokenization/processing before hitting the concurrency/quota guard. We're working on tightening that ordering to reduce surprising charges; for now we can review any specific billing spikes and offer a one-time credit if warranted." Worthy to send?

ali_eng: That wording is ok. Add that we're investigating longer-term fix (move quota checks before tokenization for bulk endpoints) and we'll follow up within 3 business days.

sara_sales: Sent to customer, they accepted the temporary bump and confirmed demo will run. They asked for post-demo artifact: logs + replay and a recommended client-side concurrency pattern.

jen_sre: I'll export the sample replay and an ops note (short) with recommended client behavior: cap concurrent sockets to <= Per-Route-Cap, use exponential backoff with jitter, and prefer client-side batching (merge small docs into a single call when possible).

ali_eng: Follow-up tasks: 1) mike_support to draft billing credit offer if spike looks anomalous, 2) jen_sre to attach replay logs, 3) eng to track long-term fix in issue INF-1379.

mike_support: Will draft the credit note after we see logs.

sara_sales: Thanks team — huge win for the deal if demo goes green. :rocket:

jen_sre: Demo finished — no more 429s once bump applied. Captured replay and saved to /internal/tenants/finops-87/replays/1759876565.log.

mike_support: Uploading draft credit note to the deal thread.

ali_eng: Adding a small postmortem to Retrospectives and linking INF-1379. We'll also consider adding an explicit UI flag for temporary demo reservations.

sara_sales: Perfect. Closing the swarm. :thumbsup:
